remarks: Freshly painted inside and out, newly installed stair & 2nd floor carpet and ready for immediate occupancy! Ideally positioned; just .3 miles the train and 250 feet to Mead Park, this three-bedroom Cape offers effortless access to daily life. A bright, sun-filled living room flows into a separate dining room, with one bedroom conveniently located on the main floor. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms offer comfortable, private space. The kitchen is outfitted with newer appliances, and the home is further equipped with central air and a full-sized washer/dryer.
